0022600025.text: The Washington Wizards (4-4, second in the Southeast and 0.5 games back, on a one-game losing streak) visit the Atlanta Hawks (5-4, first in the Southeast, on a two-game winning streak) in the Wizards' 9th game of the 2026-27 season, an Emirates NBA Cup East Group C matchup. Washington trails the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after losing 120-105 in Washington on November 4, and it lost the 2025-26 series 1-3. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Asa Newell (toe), Jalen Johnson (ankle, game-time decision) and Jock Landale (hip) are listed as day-to-day.
